The mana consumption was removed and the wand now generates 7-8 mana points per successful attack (displayed in the log as "+1/+2" and "+6 mana"). Note: Mana generation only triggers if the player's mana is below the maximum capacity.
name: Wand of Decay
notes: An upgrade from the [[Wand of Dragonbreath]] and the [[sorcerer]]'s equivalent of the [[druid]]'s [[Necrotic Rod]]. However, many [[sorcerer]]s prefer to wait until they can use the [[Wand of Draconia]], since at a lower level [[Fire Damage|fire]] is a more useful element than [[Death Damage|death]]. Provides 2 sqm of green light. Wands of Decay replaced {{Ilink|Wand of Plague}} [[Wand of Plague|Wands of Plague]] in the [[Updates/8.1|Winter Update 2007]]. Needed for [[Mage Outfits Quest]] (male) and [[Summoner Outfits Quest]] (female).
